hypothesis: The frozen term-gated short ATM straddle earns a positive per-trade return on margin, net of cost, on the 2025-2026 broad-universe block. This block was constructed after the 1,476-trial search concluded and no configuration was ever selected, tuned, or scored on it.
why_this_block_is_clean: outputs/research/events_broad_oos_2025.parquet was built by scripts/build_broad_oos_2025.py after the settled verdict. No parameter in the frozen specification was chosen with reference to any observation in it. It is the only genuinely untouched block available to the project.

data.marks: Databento OPRA cbbo-1m consolidated BBO, last bar at or before 15:59 America/New_York, window built by localise-and-convert not string concatenation
data.spot: yfinance adjusted closes, one batched panel, so entry and exit share a split basis

specification.gate: expanding causal term gate, iv_term_spread at or above the 0.80 quantile of all strictly-earlier events, MIN_HIST=25
specification.vehicle: naked short ATM straddle, nearest expiry, strike nearest spot on the entry chain
specification.exit: exit session 15:59 ET snapshot, marked at the same strike and expiry actually sold, so the buy-back is charged intrinsic plus remaining premium
specification.return: return on margin, Reg-T approximation via engine.pnl.regt_straddle_margin
specification.contract_invariance: return on margin is invariant to contract count; sizing is therefore not a free parameter here

cost_bases_reported.gross: no cost charged, diagnostic only, never the headline
cost_bases_reported.primary: 11.6% of entry premium round trip, the project's canonical break-even, identical to the basis used by scripts/backfill_forward_window.py so the two forward results are comparable

primary_statistic: per-trade Sharpe of the gated book, net at the primary cost basis

inference.annualisation: sqrt(trades per year) inferred from the block's own cadence and stated beside any annualised figure; sqrt(252) is not permitted

benchmarks.agent_0: the same universe with no gate, scored identically
benchmarks.random_gate: participation-matched random selection, seed 0, same number of trades as the term gate

success_criterion: gated net per-trade Sharpe positive with a date-clustered 95% interval excluding zero, and a positive lift over the participation-matched random gate
kill_criteria: interval contains zero: reported as not established on this block
point estimate negative: reported as a negative result, stated as plainly as the 2013-2018 holdout
fewer than 150 scored trades after mark attrition: reported as underpowered, with the achieved N and the attrition reason stated
attrition_disclosure: events dropped for unquoted legs are counted and reported by reason. Mark attrition is not random; it skews toward liquid names, which is stated wherever the result is quoted.
reporting_commitment: This result is written into all three submission documents whichever way it comes back. A clean out-of-sample block loses its entire value the moment its reporting becomes conditional on its sign.
